title: Classification of Finite Metric Spaces and Combinatorics of Convex Polytopes
exact_target: Classify finite metric spaces using the faces of their fundamental polytopes: derive the face structure from distances, count the types and generic types, find similarity criteria, determine which types occur for Euclidean metrics, and understand the topology and possible universality of the resulting classes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 4100001 (AMR-040-0001). CC BY 4.0.
